mapper.select: select pcou.id, pcou.order_number, pcou.owner_unit, ou.C_Name as ownerUnitName, pcou.project_manger, pmu.U_Name as projectMangerName, pcou.project_leader, plu.U_Name as projectLeaderName, pcou.remark from pre_change_owner_unit pcou left join sys_company ou on ou.C_ID = pcou.owner_unit left join sys_user pmu on pmu.U_ID = pcou.project_manger left join sys_user plu on plu.U_ID = pcou.project_leader where pcou.pprc_id = #{pprcId} order by order_number asc
